# F17b/F17c stale-SOS decision point: ONE scenario set replayed by the iOS store
# test (ios/Tests/IosNativeSosDeliveryStoreTests.swift), the Android guard test
# (android/src/test/.../ProtectionSosStaleGuardTest.kt) and the Dart contract test
# (test/device/own_tag_sos_frame_gate_test.dart). Native is the only classifier:
# the Dart test cannot run either store; it feeds the Dart-path frames as raw
# BLE notifications through BleDeviceRuntimeProvider, answers with the native
# verdicts asserted here and checks what Dart does with them (it never
# classifies).
#
# Line format (plain text: the Android unit-test classpath has no JSON parser):
#   <t_ms> <event> [key=value ...] => <action> [stop=cancel|resolve] [notice=true|false] [armed=true|false]
# events:
#   seen source=native|native_unclaimed|dart|none node=N age=MS
#                         what native saw of the SOS before the SDK closed it:
#                         native = its own cycle, handed over (countdown elapsed,
#                         create claimed by the SDK); native_unclaimed = its own
#                         cycle reached its create but the SDK never claimed
#                         it (runtime armed, cycle not handed over); dart = own-TAG frames that
#                         Dart forwarded (observeOwnTagSosFrame), the first one
#                         age ms before the terminal; none = nothing
#   terminal kind=cancel|resolve node=N connected=true|false
#                         the SDK's cancel/resolve (closeNativeSosCycle); arms
#                         the guard only when the SOS was seen on any path
#   frame node=N source=native|dart [delivered=MS]
#                         one BLE SOS push as delivered by that path; for a
#                         dart frame t is Dart's receivedAtMs and delivered
#                         the native clock when it reached native (default t).
#                         Native counts a Dart frame at its receivedAtMs when
#                         plausible (not in the future, at most 5 s old; never
#                         before the last counted push), else at delivery
#   decide                the 2.0 s decision timer of the open candidate
#   close source=native|dart [node=N]
#                         the TAG's own close frame 0xE1/0xE2/0xE3, any path;
#                         another TAG's close never ends the guard
#   link_drop | link_up [source=native|dart] | session
#                         source=dart: Dart's own link note (noteOwnTagSosLink),
#                         which never resets a burst being counted
#   sdk_open              the SDK opened a new SOS lifecycle (Dart disarms native)
# actions: pass (normal path: not armed / ignored / disarmed), pending, duplicate,
#          newSos, stale, none, - (no frame decision for this event).
#          Dart verdicts: pass -> proceed, newSos -> newSos, others -> suppress.
# Times are ms since the scenario start. Firmware facts: every push arrives
# twice (SOS + TEL characteristic, ms apart); a TAG countdown pushes every
# 500 ms in its first 2 s; an ACTIVE/ACK SOS pushes once per retry
# (2/8/20 s, then 60 s). The same push can also arrive through both paths.

scenario cancel_while_disconnected_then_reconnect
0 seen source=native node=7 age=30000 => -
0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=false => - armed=true
1000 link_drop => - armed=true
200000 link_up => - armed=true
230000 frame node=7 source=native => pending
230005 frame node=7 source=native => duplicate
232000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=true armed=true
290000 frame node=7 source=native => pending
290005 frame node=7 source=native => duplicate
292000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=false armed=true

scenario ios_stale_frame_through_both_paths_is_one_push
0 seen source=native node=7 age=30000 => -
0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=false => - armed=true
200000 link_up => - armed=true
230000 frame node=7 source=native => pending
230004 frame node=7 source=dart => duplicate
230008 frame node=7 source=native => duplicate
230012 frame node=7 source=dart => duplicate
232000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=true armed=true

scenario ios_stale_frame_reaches_dart_first
0 seen source=native node=7 age=30000 => -
0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=false => - armed=true
200000 link_up => - armed=true
230000 frame node=7 source=dart => pending
230003 frame node=7 source=native => duplicate
230006 frame node=7 source=dart => duplicate
232000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=true armed=true

# F17c review M-D: original H2. The native runtime saw the SOS but its create
# was never claimed by the SDK (not handed over): no guard on any path, even
# though Dart forwarded frames past the countdown.
scenario unclaimed_native_create_arms_nothing
0 seen source=native_unclaimed node=7 age=30000 => -
0 seen source=dart node=7 age=30000 => -
0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=true => - armed=false
10000 frame node=7 source=dart => pass armed=false

# M-B: a Dart link note (also an owner handover native<->Dart) mid-burst
# never turns a genuine countdown into a stale stop.
scenario dart_link_flap_mid_burst_is_still_a_new_sos
0 seen source=dart node=7 age=30000 => -
0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=false => - armed=true
100000 link_up => - armed=true
120000 frame node=7 source=dart => pending
120200 link_drop source=dart => - armed=true
120300 link_up source=dart => - armed=true
120500 frame node=7 source=dart => pending
121000 frame node=7 source=dart => newSos armed=false

scenario dart_link_note_keeps_the_open_stale_decision

0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=false => - armed=true
100000 link_up => - armed=true
120000 frame node=7 source=dart => pending
120300 link_up source=dart => - armed=true
122000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=true armed=true

# Dual path: a late Dart copy of a push native already counted stays a copy,
# even when it reaches native after the next push.
scenario dual_path_late_dart_copy_of_a_stale_pair_is_still_one_push

120500 frame node=7 source=native => pending
120002 frame node=7 source=dart delivered=120600 => duplicate
120502 frame node=7 source=dart delivered=120610 => duplicate
122000 decide => stale stop=cancel notice=true armed=true

# Low: another TAG's close frame forwarded by Dart never ends this guard.
scenario other_tag_close_through_dart_never_ends_the_guard

0 terminal kind=cancel node=7 connected=true => - armed=true
5000 close source=dart node=99 => - armed=true
10000 frame node=7 source=dart => pending
